    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Python中绘制R的科研级可视化图</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2>一、重要的桥接Python库</h2>
<pre>rpy2# pip install rpy2   我的R语言版本为 4.1.3 ，需要rpy2 3.5.X版本去对应</pre>
<h2>二、确保R环境</h2>
<pre><em>确保你电脑已安装 R，并在 R 里装好相关包：# install.packages(c("ggplot2", "ggstatsplot", "patchwork","</em>ggpmisc"))</pre>
<p><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>注意：这里可能遇到几个问题：</strong></span></p>
<h3><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">1.rpy2同python同R的版本兼容问题</span></h3>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>可能有报错：</strong>ffi.error: symbol 'R_getVar' not found in library 'E:\R\Rlangrage\R-4.1.3\bin\x64\R.dll': error 0x7f</span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">此时需要调整rpy2版本使得三方同时适配</span></p>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">如：Python 3.9 + R 4.1.3 可以加载 rpy2&nbsp; 3.5.x&nbsp; 版本</span>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">2.R中没有相关的库/包</span></h3>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>可能有报错：</strong>rpy2.robjects.packages.PackageNotInstalledError: The R package "ggplot2" is not installed.</span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">方法：指定版本下载</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>install.packages(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Archive/ggplot2/ggplot2_3.4.2.tar.gz</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                 repos </span>= NULL, type = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">source</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>可能有报错：</strong>rpy2.rinterface_lib.embedded.RRuntimeError: Error in library(ggstatsplot) : there is no package called 'ggstatsplot'</p>
<p>方法：安装兼容 R 4.1.3 的旧版 <code>ggstatsplot</code></p>
<p>一般方法较为困难，这里采用屏幕快照，穿越回4.1.3适用的当年进行下载：</p>
<p>①打开 R 4.1.3 控制台<span>，先设置镜像为 MRAN 快照（这里选择 2022-08-15，R 4.1.3 稳定期）：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>options(repos = c(CRAN = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://cran.microsoft.com/snapshot/2022-08-15/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>))</pre>
</div>
<p>②<span>直接安装<span style="font-family: &quot;times new roman&quot;, times; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> <code>ggstatsplot、</code></span></span><span style="font-family: &quot;times new roman&quot;, times; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ggpmisc</span></p>
<p><span><code></code><span>，它会自动从该快照拉取兼容版本的依赖包（<code>correlation</code><span>, <code>datawizard</code><span>, <code>patchwork</code><span> 等全部是当时的老版本）</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>install.packages(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ggstatsplot</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>③如果提示需要 Rtools 编译（Windows 下极少发生，快照提供二进制），就先装 <a href="https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/Rtools/rtools40.html" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank">Rtools40</a>，安装时勾选“Add Rtools to system PATH”。</p>
<p>备用：如果 MRAN 快照连接失败，可改用其它历史镜像，例如：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>options(repos = c(CRAN = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://packagemanager.rstudio.com/cran/__linux__/focal/2022-08-15</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>))</pre>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>options(repos = c(CRAN = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://packagemanager.posit.co/cran/2022-08-15</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>))</pre>
</div>
<p><strong>当报错：</strong>Warning: unable to access index for repository https://cran.microsoft.com/snapshot/2022-08-15/src/contrib: 无法打开URL'https://cran.microsoft.com/snapshot/2022-08-15/src/contrib/PACKAGES'即表示该快照或穿越路线失效需要更换快照路径</p>
<h3>3.语言环境错误</h3>
<p>可能有报错：UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0xb2 in position 32: invalid start byte</p>
<p>方法：在 Python 中强制 R 使用英文消息声明：</p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>在导入 <code>rpy2</code><span> 后、任何绘图前，加一行：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>ro.r(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Sys.setenv(LANGUAGE="en")</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>)</pre>
</div>
<h2>三、绘图测试</h2>
<h3><span>例 1：<code>ggstatsplot</code><span> —— 一行代码带统计检验的箱线图</span></span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">R 独有优势<span>：自动进行方差分析 / t 检验，并把 p 值、效应量、显著性标注直接画在图上，符合顶刊风格。Python 生态目前没有<span>同等级别的库。</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pandas as pd
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> rpy2.robjects as ro
ro.r(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Sys.setenv(LANGUAGE="en")</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> rpy2.robjects <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pandas2ri
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> rpy2.robjects.packages <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> importr

pandas2ri.activate()

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 生成一些三组数据</span>
df =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pd.DataFrame({
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">score</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: [85, 90, 88, 92, 87, 70, 75, 72, 68, 71, 55, 60, 58, 62, 59<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">method</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">A</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>]*5 + [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">B</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>]*5 + [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">C</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>]*5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
})
ro.globalenv[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">df</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> df

ro.r(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'''</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
library(ggplot2)
library(ggstatsplot)
p &lt;- ggbetweenstats(
  data = df,
  x = method,
  y = score,
  type = "parametric",
  title = "Comparison of Teaching Methods",
  caption = "Auto: F-value, p-value, eta^2"
)
ggsave("statsplot.png", p, width=8, height=5, dpi=300)
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'''</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 用你的默认图片查看器打开</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os
os.startfile(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">statsplot.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p><img alt="image" width="689" height="431" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2958730/202606/2958730-20260620231724759-1151543057.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">学习点<span>：</span></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>你不用自己写 <code>scipy.stats.f_oneway</code><span>，不用算效应量，不用手工在图上标 p 值。</span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>ggstatsplot</code><span> 自动完成统计推断 + 可视化，是沟通数据分析与论文插图的终极捷径。</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>这种图在心理学、医学、教育学等需要展示统计结果的社会科学期刊中极受欢迎。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3><span>例 2：<code>patchwork</code><span> 拼图 —— 任意组合多张图，对齐出版级</span></span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">R 独有优势<span>：像搭积木一样用 <code>|</code><span>、<code>/</code><span>、<code>+</code><span> 组合多幅 <code>ggplot2</code><span> 图，自动对齐坐标轴、图例、边距。Python 的 <code>matplotlib</code><span> 子图布局难以达到同样的精确度和美学。</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pandas as pd
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> rpy2.robjects as ro
ro.r(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Sys.setenv(LANGUAGE="en")</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> rpy2.robjects <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pandas2ri
pandas2ri.activate()

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 直接拿 ggplot2 里的 mpg 数据</span>
ro.globalenv[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mpg</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] = ro.r(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ggplot2::mpg</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

ro.r(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'''</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

p1 &lt;- ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, hwy)) + 
        geom_point(aes(color = class)) + 
        geom_smooth(se = FALSE) + 
        theme_minimal()

p2 &lt;- ggplot(mpg, aes(class)) + 
        geom_bar(fill = "steelblue") + 
        coord_flip() + 
        theme_minimal()

p3 &lt;- ggplot(mpg, aes(cty, hwy)) + 
        geom_point(alpha = 0.3) + 
        facet_wrap(~ year) + 
        theme_minimal()

combined &lt;- (p1 / p2) | p3 + 
  plot_annotation(title = "汽车数据多维度展示", tag_levels = 'A')

ggsave("patchwork_demo.png", combined, width=12, height=7, dpi=300)
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'''</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

os.startfile(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">patchwork_demo.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p><img alt="patchwork_demo" width="672" height="392" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2958730/202606/2958730-20260620231804716-1258136765.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">学习点<span>：</span></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>patchwork</code><span> 的布局语法极其直观：<code>(A / B) | C</code><span> 表示 A 在 B 上面，整列再与 C 左右排列。</span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>自动对齐坐标轴、图例位置，输出图片可直接用于论文，无需后期手动微调。</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>这种“写代码像设计版面”的体验，是目前 <code>matplotlib</code><span> 的 <code>subplot2grid</code><span> 等难以企及的。</span></span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3><span>例 3：高级 <code>ggplot2</code><span> 分面 + 统计变换 + 自定义标注</span></span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">R 独有优势<span>：分面时在每个子图上自动计算并标注相关系数、回归线，使用 <code>after_stat</code><span> 等先进统计变换，Python 的 <code>plotnine</code><span> 只能完成基础分面。</span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> os
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pandas as pd
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> rpy2.robjects as ro
ro.r(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Sys.setenv(LANGUAGE="en")</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> rpy2.robjects <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pandas2ri
pandas2ri.activate()

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 生成模拟数据</span>
df =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pd.DataFrame({
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">x</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: [1,2,3,4,5]*3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">y</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: [2,4,6,8,10, 1,4,7,10,13, 3,5,7,9,11<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">group</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">线性A</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>]*5 + [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">线性B</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>]*5 + [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">线性C</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>]*5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
})
ro.globalenv[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">df</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> df

ro.r(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'''</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpmisc)  # 提供 geom_text_npc 等标注函数

p &lt;- ggplot(df, aes(x, y, color = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ group, scales = "free") +
  stat_poly_eq(
    aes(label = paste(..eq.label.., ..rr.label.., sep = "~~~")),
    formula = y ~ x, 
    parse = TRUE
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(title = "分面自动标注回归方程和 R²")

ggsave("facet_annotation.png", p, width=10, height=4, dpi=300)
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'''</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

os.startfile(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">facet_annotation.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p><img alt="facet_annotation" width="669" height="268" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2958730/202606/2958730-20260620231840755-1854718648.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">学习点<span>：</span></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>stat_poly_eq</code><span> 能自动计算回归方程和 R²，并以数学公式形式渲染在图上，这在你需要展示趋势线的统计结果时极为有用。</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>facet_wrap</code><span> 配合 <code>scales="free"</code><span> 让每个分面都有自己的坐标尺度，这很贴合实际数据分析。</span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>这种“统计结果直接呈现在图形元素中”的能力，是 R 可视化最深邃的美学之一。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>由此可以展开Python和R的结合，Python解决工程代码+数学逻辑，R专项负责可视化部分实现两者结合。</strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>四、绘图包装</h2>
<p>①Python给数据（dataframe格式）</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">mport os
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pandas as pd
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Rplot
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 生成模拟数据</span>
df =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pd.DataFrame({
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">x</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: [1,2,3,4,5]*3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">y</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: [2,4,6,8,10, 1,4,7,10,13, 3,5,7,9,11<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">],
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">group</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>: [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">线性A</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>]*5 + [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">线性B</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>]*5 + [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">线性C</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>]*5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
})
Rtext</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'''</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpmisc)  # 提供 geom_text_npc 等标注函数

p &lt;- ggplot(Data, aes(x, y, color = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ group, scales = "free") +
  stat_poly_eq(
    aes(label = paste(..eq.label.., ..rr.label.., sep = "~~~")),
    formula = y ~ x, 
    parse = TRUE
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(title = "分面自动标注回归方程和 R²")

ggsave("Output.png", p, width=10, height=4, dpi=300)
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'''</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
Rplot.PyRplot(Data</span>=df,Rtext=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Rtext)

os.startfile(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Output.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>②R绘图</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pandas as pd
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> rpy2.robjects as ro
ro.r(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Sys.setenv(LANGUAGE="en")</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> rpy2.robjects <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pandas2ri
pandas2ri.activate()
ro.globalenv[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mpg</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] = ro.r(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ggplot2::mpg</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PyRplot(Data,Rtext):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> isinstance(Data, pd.DataFrame):
        data </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> pd.DataFrame(Data)
    ro.globalenv[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Data</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Data
    ro.r(Rtext)
    ro.r(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">rm(Data)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>)  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 用后即删，保持环境干净</span></pre>
